neighbours.label: ' to' or ' à' after going or gone to a place or event (going to the beach, allé à Vancouver), or ' attend'
fire: We love hiking, fishing and going to the lake.
I have been going to this barber for ten years.
It will be great fun to go to the fair.
Nous sommes allés à Montréal pour le festival.
She enjoys cooking, knitting and going to concerts.
They are going to the museum on Saturday.
Je suis allée à Paris avec ma soeur.
Next year we plan to attend the conference.
quiet: We love hiking, fishing and reading books.
I am going to cut this hedge in ten days.
It will be great fun to learn the song.
Nous allons manger pour le festival.
She enjoys cooking, knitting and writing letters.
They are going to paint the fence on Saturday.
Je vais parler avec ma soeur.
Next year we plan to sell the house.

short: going to a place or event
notes: Card: ' to' x16, ' attend' x4, ' a' x3, ' à' x2, ' the' x2, ' of'. Probes: ' à' 1.021, ' to' 0.916, 0.686, 0.448, ' attend' 0.529; 'going to fix' 0.127, 'reading novels' 0.019. Near misses keep ' going to' as a future auxiliary, so the token alone can't pass.
